programmes.d: The Master paves the way for an invasion by the insidious Nestene consciousness.
The Master uses his hypnotic powers to take control of a factory where he creates Autons.
The only clue to the Master's plans is a single plastic daffodil.
The Master is broadcasting an activation signal to open a channel for the Nestenes.
The Doctor tests a machine designed to extract evil particles from the brains of convicted criminals.
Prisoners revolt at the institute where the mind machine is being tested.
The Doctor is captured by the Master and fitted with a telepathic amplifier.
The Doctor decides to destroy the parasite in the mind machine, but it has dematerialized.
The Master and Doctor join forces to destroy the machine.
The Master bargains for the dematerialization circuit for his time machine.
(1/4) Axos lands on Earth and the Axons offer the gift of the miraculous Axonite.
(2/4) The Master is in league with the Axons who intend to consume the Earth.
(3/4) The Axons attempt to force the Doctor to give them the secret of time travel.
(4/4) The Doctor and the Master plan to escape the Earth, leaving it to Axos and its fate.
The TARDIS takes the Doctor and Jo to the future where colonists are menaced by a monster.
The Interplanetary Mining Corporation, led by Captain Dent, arrives on the planet.
When Jo attempts to break into the IMC ship she is captured and held hostage.
The Master pretends to have come to settle the dispute between the colonists and IMC.
The Master forces the Doctor to take him to the underground city of the primitives.
The Doctor and the Master confront the guardian of the doomsday weapon.
The Doctor tries to prevent Professor Horner from breaking into an ancient barrow.
Devil's End is sealed off from the outside world by a heat barrier.
The Doctor attempts to help the Brigadier penetrate the heat barrier.
The Doctor is captured by the villagers who are under the Master's control.
UNIT have penetrated the heat barrier and launch an attack on the gargoyle, Bok.
Freedom fighters, trying to change history by traveling back in time to prevent the Daleks from conquering Earth, start a temporal paradox. With Jon Pertwee.
Jo tampers with one of the travelers' time machines and is transported into the future.

programmes.t: Doctor Who: The Evil of the Daleks
programmes.d: Jamie explores Maxtible's house; the Doctor is forced by the Daleks to subject his companion to a series of tests.
The rebel humans are about to change history and the Doctor tries to stop them.
The planet Peladon is hoping to join the Galactic Federation.
The work of the committee is hampered by sabotage, fear and suspicion.
The Doctor is sentenced to a fight to the death.
Hepesh is revealed to be behind the attacks.
The Doctor tries to make peace with reptilian Sea Devils persuaded by the Master to help him dominate man. With Jon Pertwee.

The Doctor discovers that the sea creatures are kin to the Silurians, a race he once helped destroy.
The Master devises equipment to contact the sea creatures and help them regain control of Earth.
The Master and the Sea Devils form an alliance.
The Doctor is brought before the chief Sea Devil and counsels peace.
Under duress, the Doctor helps the Master repair a unit that may revive Sea Devils globally.

The Doctor is sent to a skybase orbiting the planet of Solos in the 30th century, where he must deliver a sealed message pod; on the planet below, something is transforming the human population into hideous mutants.
Ky flees to the planet's poisonous surface, taking Jo with him; the Marshal, holding the Doctor captive, demands that he opens the message pod.
The Doctor gives the box to Ky, revealing the contents to be scrolls written in the language of the Old Ones.
The Doctor and Sondergaard make a discovery in the caves of Solos while Jo falls into the Marshal's trap.
The Doctor and Jo are once again sent into danger by the Time Lords when they are given a vital message capsule to deliver.
The Marshal is on trial, with the Doctor as chief witness; Jo and the Doctor's friends are the Marshal's prisoners.
The Master plans to seize the Crystal of Kronos, gaining power over time itself.
The Master manages to transmit the Lost City's High Priest through time into his laboratory.
The High Priest reveals that the Master has only a portion of the crystal that resides in the temple vaults.
Kronos attacks the Doctor.
The Doctor is transported to an eternity of nothingness, as the Master arrives in Atlantis.
